evidence.name: Screen field: Full-Screen Background Photo
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Full-Screen Background Photo" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Full-Screen Background Photo
sections.description: Uploads an image that fills the screen background when the background is set to Photo. It scales to cover the whole screen, so edges can get cropped on different phone sizes, keep your focal point centered. If you put text on top, choose a darker or dimmed image so your copy stays readable.
